note: City of Pembina campground inside the ring dike at the Pembina and Red rivers, by the border crossing. Boat ramp and pier, fish-cleaning station, playground and disc golf; LaMoure Memorial Golf Course next door. With the Stutsman Bridge to South Pembina closed indefinitely, the city routes campers in from I-29 exit 212 via 105th St NE and Old 81 (city page, November 2026). --Claude
summary: City page confirms 14 RV spaces at $25 with water, sewer and 30/50-amp, tents $10, FCFS only, shower seasonal; 'CLOSED UNTIL MAY'. Groups now manual; the note's 'Primitive tent sites' replaced (it is an RV campground); access detour added. Not waterfront stands (behind a ring dike).
flags: NOTE CORRECTION: the stored note described 'Primitive tent sites' only; the city page sells 14 RV spaces with full hookups. Note rewritten.

SEASON: the city page says 'The Ft. Daer Campgrounds is CLOSED UNTIL MAY!' and gives water/sewer and the shower 'Seasonally from May to October'; no closing date for the campground itself, so season carries a note only (no opens/closes written). A reviewer may set opens 05-01.

ACCESS: 'Due to the Stutsman Bridge to South Pembina being closed indefinitely, the Ft. Daer Campgrounds may be accessed by taking Interstate 29 to Exit 212, then taking 105th St. NE to Old 81' (in the note).

LONG-STAY: the city also offers a monthly Kneeshaw Circle site ($240/month) but 'Long term stay is not available 2026-2027'; the campground itself is nightly first-come. No long-stay concern. Google 5.0 (1 review); presence = the city's own page with phone.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. The only Esri image is under a major flood; the RV lane (campers at ~48.9651,-97.2397) sits inside a grassed ring dike, and the normal Red/Pembina channels lie beyond the dike and a wooded floodplain. Behind a berm, no water view: default down.
Pin 48.96500,-97.24000 is on the RV lane; keep. Website (city page, 200) and phone (701) 825-6819 (page: 701.825.6819) keep.
